SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM plants

SELECT plants.id, plants.taxon_id, plants.scientific_name, plants.common_name, plants.category, plants.planting_place, plants.description, plants.common_diseases, plants.care_data, plants.icon_url, plants.image_url, plants.created_at 
FROM plants ORDER BY plants.created_at DESC 
 LIMIT $1::INTEGER OFFSET $2::INTEGER

SELECT taxons.id AS taxons_id, taxons.name AS taxons_name, taxons.rank AS taxons_rank, taxons.parent_id AS taxons_parent_id, taxons.description AS taxons_description, taxons.created_at AS taxons_created_at, taxons.updated_at AS taxons_updated_at 
FROM taxons 
WHERE taxons.id IN ($1::UUID, $2::UUID, $3::UUID, $4::UUID, $5::UUID, $6::UUID, $7::UUID, $8::UUID, $9::UUID, $10::UUID, $11::UUID, $12::UUID, $13::UUID, $14::UUID, $15::UUID, $16::UUID, $17::UUID, $18::UUID, $19::UUID)

SELECT count(*) AS count_1 
FROM projects

SELECT projects.id, projects.name, projects.client_name, projects.location, projects.description, projects.created_at, projects.updated_at, (SELECT count(projectplants.plant_id) AS count_1 
FROM projectplants 
WHERE projectplants.project_id = projects.id) AS plant_count 
FROM projects ORDER BY projects.updated_at DESC 
 LIMIT $1::INTEGER OFFSET $2::INTEGER

SELECT count(plants.id) AS count_1

FROM (SELECT categories.id AS id, categories.name AS name, categories.description AS description, count(plants.id) AS count_2 
FROM categories LEFT OUTER JOIN plants ON categories.name = plants.category GROUP BY categories.id, categories.name, categories.description) AS anon_1

SELECT categories.id, categories.name, categories.description, count(plants.id) AS count_1
